Package net.sf.jguiraffe.gui.app

Schnittstelle ApplicationShutdownListener

Alle Superschnittstellen:
EventListener
public interface ApplicationShutdownListener extends EventListener

Definition of an interface for listeners that want to be notified when the application terminates.

Objects implementing this interface can register itself at the global Application object. They will then receive a notification before this application terminates. So it is possible to perform some clean up before the final shutdown.

A shutdown listeners has also the opportunity of canceling the shutdown process. An example would be an application that shows a message box asking whether the user really wants to exit. If the user here enters "No", the shutdown must be aborted.

  • Methodendetails

    • canShutdown

      boolean canShutdown(Application app)
      Checks if a shutdown is possible. This method is called by the application in the beginning of the shutdown phase for all registered listeners. Only if all listeners return true, shutdown process will be continued.
      Parameter:
      app - the associated application
      Gibt zurück:
      a flag if this listeners allows a shutdown

    • shutdown

      void shutdown(Application app)
      Notifies this listener that the associated application terminates now. This method is called for all registered listeners after a call to canShutdown() was successful, i.e. none of the listeners canceled the process. An implementation could e.g. ensure that all changes have been saved or perform clean up.
      Parameter:
      app - the associated application
